{{Top|notoc=1}}
{{Quote|Get the engines warmed up!|Han Solo, to Chewbacca|<ref name="repairs">{{SWComicCite|7.5|Repairs}}</ref>}}
[[File:CheckOutMySpeeder-EotE.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] working on the engine of a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]]]]
An '''engine''', '''drive''', or '''thruster''', was a machine specially designed to propel vehicles through the [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]], navigate the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] or launch a [[Starship/Legends|spaceship]] into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] for interstellar voyage.

The technologies of engines that allowed this three categories of advanced travel to exist were:
*[[Repulsorlift/Legends|Repulsorlift]] {{C|For use in the nearby of a gravitational force and near-orbit planetary travel}}
*[[Sublight engine/Legends|Sublight engine]] {{C|For extended operations in System space or Deep space}}
*[[Hyperdrive/Legends|Hyperdrive]] {{C|For interplanetary and interstellar travels}}

{{Tech-stub}}
